_about: Geometry for the RGA clearance check of the RIKEN BDR Fluent 780 (io/fluent/rga_clearance.py). Millimetres, deck
coordinates of FluentControl (X to the right, Y to the back, Z up). Positions are TCP (tool centre point) positions
of the RGA: the point between the finger tips at the grip height.
- RGA parts: from the collision model FluentControl's PathFinder dumps for the RGA (X3D of the fingers, the gripper
assembly blocks, the rotator and the pillar), expressed relative to the TCP. u is the direction from the TCP to the
rotation axis (C=180: +X, C=90: -Y), v is u turned by +90 degrees, z is height above the TCP.
- Site positions, grip heights, C and gripper widths: from the RGA move lines of FluentControl's log
(PostPath / PrePath points and 'Move is finished' positions) of the RGA moves of 2026-11-18.
- Fixed objects: from the PathFinder dump and the worktable, rounded; see the status of each.
- Object heights: estimated from the grip heights and the labware definitions; the 1000 ul rack from FluentControl's
status: 'measured' = read from the instrument's log or FluentControl's model; 'estimated' = derived from measured
values; 'assumed' = not verified on the instrument (listed in README, section RGA clearance check).
Validated against 11 real events (5 collisions, 6 clear moves; tests/io/fluent/test_rga_clearance.py).
_worktables: the check refuses to run on any other worktable (fluent.definitions.workspace): the site positions belong to this deck
